mapper.select: SELECT t1.ptcp_inst_sn, /* 참여기관일련번호 */ t1.pblnt_sn, /* 공시일련번호 */ t1.inst_id, /* 기관아이디 */ t1.brno, /* 사업자등록번호 */ t2.inst_nm, /* 기관명 */ t1.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd, /* 업로드진행상태코드 */ t1.ptcp_dmnd_dt, /* 참여요청일시 */ t1.ptcp_cfmtn_dt, /* 참여확정일시 */ t1.ptcp_rtrcn_dt, /* 참여철회일시 */ t1.ptcp_reg_dt, /* 참여등록일시 */ t1.ptcp_cmptn_dt, /* 참여완료일시 */ t1.ptcp_rdmnd_dt, /* 참여재요청일시 */ t1.uld_type_cd, /* 업로드유형코드 */ t1.uld_dt, /* 업로드일시 */ t1.ver_info_nm, /* 버전정보명 */ t1.last_updt_ymd, /* 최종업데이트일 */ t1.updt_cycle_cnt, /* 업데이트주기횟수 */ t1.del_yn, /* 삭제여부 */ t1.rgtr_id, /* 등록자아이디 */ t1.reg_dt, /* 등록일시 */ t1.mdfr_id, /* 수정자아이디 */ t1.mdfcn_dt /* 수정일시 */ FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PRST t1 INNER JOIN kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PBLNT pblnt ON pblnt.pblnt_sn = t1.pblnt_sn AND (pblnt.del_yn IS NULL OR pblnt.del_yn = 'N') LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_INST t2 ON TRIM(t1.inst_id) = TRIM(t2.brno) WHERE t1.pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} AND (t1.del_yn IS NULL OR TRIM(t1.del_yn) = '' OR UPPER(TRIM(t1.del_yn)) = 'N') ORDER BY t1.reg_dt DESC

UPDATE kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PRST SET del_yn = 'Y', /* 삭제여부 */ mdfcn_dt = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP /* 수정일시 */ WHERE pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} /* 공시일련번호 */

WHERE pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} /* 공시일련번호 */ AND ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} /* 참여기관번호 */ AND (del_yn IS NULL OR del_yn = 'N')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kids_own.TB_CM_D_ULD_PRD_SCL ( uld_prd_sn, pblnt_sn, ptcp_inst_sn, trsf_se_cd, tbl_se_cd, tnocs, bgng_ymd, end_ymd, del_yn, rgtr_id, reg_dt, mdfr_id, mdfcn_dt ) VALUES ( (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(uld_prd_sn), 0) + 1 FROM kids_own.TB_CM_D_ULD_PRD_SCL), #{pblntSn}, #{ptcpInstSn}, #{trsfSeCd}, #{tblSeCd}, #{tnocs}, #{bgngYmd}, #{endYmd}, 'N', #{rgtrId}, #{regDt}, #{rgtrId}, #{regDt} )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_CTLG ( uld_list_sn, pblnt_sn, ptcp_inst_sn, tbl_se_cd, col_nm, data_type_nm, nul_yn, pk_yn, fk_yn, del_yn, rgtr_id, reg_dt, mdfr_id, mdfcn_dt ) VALUES ( (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(uld_list_sn), 0) + 1 FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_CTLG), #{pblntSn}, #{ptcpInstSn}, #{tblSeCd}, #{colNm}, #{dataTypeCd}, #{nullYn}, #{pkYn}, #{fkYn}, 'N', #{rgtrId}, #{regDt}, #{rgtrId}, #{regDt} )

mapper.select: SELECT ver_info_nm AS "verInfoNm", last_updt_ymd AS "lastUpdtYmd", updt_cycle_cnt AS "updtCycleCnt" FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PRST WHERE pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} AND ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND (del_yn IS NULL OR del_yn = 'N') ORDER BY CASE WHEN NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(ver_info_nm, '')), '') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, mdfcn_dt DESC NULLS LAST, reg_dt DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

SELECT uld_list_sn AS "uldListSn", tbl_se_cd AS "tblSeCd", col_nm AS "colNm", data_type_nm AS "dataTypeNm", nul_yn AS "nullYn", pk_yn AS "pkYn", fk_yn AS "fkYn" FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_CTLG WHERE pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} AND ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND (del_yn IS NULL OR del_yn = 'N') ORDER BY uld_list_sn

SELECT chg_rsn_info_cn /* 변경사유정보내용 */ FROM kids_own.TB_CM_E_ULD_STTS_CHG WHERE pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} AND ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd = '04' /* 참여취소 상태 */ AND (del_yn IS NULL OR del_yn = 'N') ORDER BY reg_dt DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE kids_own.TB_CM_E_ULD_STTS_CHG SET chg_rsn_info_cn = #{cancelReason}, /* 변경사유정보내용 */ mdfr_id = #{mdfrId}, /* 수정자아이디 */ mdfcn_dt = #{mdfcnDt} /* 수정일시 */ WHERE pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} AND ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd = '04' /* 참여취소 상태 */ AND (del_yn IS NULL OR del_yn = 'N') AND uld_stts_chg_sn = ( SELECT uld_stts_chg_sn FROM kids_own.TB_CM_E_ULD_STTS_CHG WHERE pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} AND ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd = '04' AND (del_yn IS NULL OR del_yn = 'N') ORDER BY reg_dt DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT prst.pblnt_sn AS "pblntSn", pblnt.ttl_nm AS "pblntTtlNm", prst.reg_dt AS "regDt", prst.rgtr_id AS "rgtrId", COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(emp.emp_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(mbr.encpt_mbr_flnm), ''), prst.rgtr_id) AS "rgtrNm", prst.ver_info_nm AS "verInfoNm", prst.last_updt_ymd AS "lastUpdtYmd", prst.updt_cycle_cnt AS "updtCycleCnt" FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PRST prst INNER JOIN kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PBLNT pblnt ON pblnt.pblnt_sn = prst.pblnt_sn AND (pblnt.del_yn IS NULL OR pblnt.del_yn = 'N') LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_emp_info emp ON TRIM(COALESCE(prst.rgtr_id, '')) = TRIM(COALESCE(emp.emp_no, '')) LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_MBR_INFO mbr ON TRIM(COALESCE(prst.rgtr_id, '')) = TRIM(COALESCE(mbr.mbr_id, '')) WHERE prst.pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} AND prst.ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND (prst.del_yn IS NULL OR prst.del_yn = 'N') ORDER BY prst.reg_dt DESC

SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(k) FROM ( SELECT TRIM(NULLIF(TRIM(prst.inst_id), '')) AS k FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PRST prst INNER JOIN kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PBLNT p ON p.pblnt_sn = prst.pblnt_sn AND (p.del_yn IS NULL OR TRIM(p.del_yn) = '' OR UPPER(TRIM(p.del_yn)) = 'N') WHERE prst.pblnt_sn <> #{excludePblntSn} AND (prst.del_yn IS NULL OR TRIM(prst.del_yn) = '' OR UPPER(TRIM(prst.del_yn)) = 'N') AND TRIM(COALESCE(p.pblnt_prgrs_stts_cd, '')) NOT IN ('03', '3') AND TRIM(COALESCE(prst.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd, '')) NOT IN ('04', '4') AND TRIM(NULLIF(TRIM(prst.inst_id), '')) != '' UNION SELECT TRIM(NULLIF(TRIM(prst.brno), '')) AS k FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PRST prst INNER JOIN kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PBLNT p ON p.pblnt_sn = prst.pblnt_sn AND (p.del_yn IS NULL OR TRIM(p.del_yn) = '' OR UPPER(TRIM(p.del_yn)) = 'N') WHERE prst.pblnt_sn <> #{excludePblntSn} AND (prst.del_yn IS NULL OR TRIM(prst.del_yn) = '' OR UPPER(TRIM(prst.del_yn)) = 'N') AND TRIM(COALESCE(p.pblnt_prgrs_stts_cd, '')) NOT IN ('03', '3') AND TRIM(COALESCE(prst.uld_inst_prgrs_stts_cd, '')) NOT IN ('04', '4') AND TRIM(NULLIF(TRIM(prst.brno), '')) != '' ) t WHERE TRIM(k) != ''

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(emp_contact.emp_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(mbr_contact.encpt_mbr_flnm), ''), inst.rgtr_id) AS "instContact", COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(emp_mgr.emp_nm), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(mbr_mgr.encpt_mbr_flnm), ''), inst.mdfr_id) AS "instManager" FROM kids_own.TB_CM_M_ULD_PRST prst INNER JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_INST inst ON TRIM(prst.inst_id) = TRIM(inst.brno) AND (inst.del_yn IS NULL OR inst.del_yn = 'N') LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_emp_info emp_contact ON TRIM(COALESCE(inst.rgtr_id, '')) = TRIM(COALESCE(emp_contact.emp_no, '')) LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_MBR_INFO mbr_contact ON TRIM(COALESCE(inst.rgtr_id, '')) = TRIM(COALESCE(mbr_contact.mbr_id, '')) LEFT JOIN kids_own.tb_pp_m_emp_info emp_mgr ON TRIM(COALESCE(inst.mdfr_id, '')) = TRIM(COALESCE(emp_mgr.emp_no, '')) LEFT JOIN kids_own.TB_PP_M_MBR_INFO mbr_mgr ON TRIM(COALESCE(inst.mdfr_id, '')) = TRIM(COALESCE(mbr_mgr.mbr_id, '')) WHERE prst.pblnt_sn = #{pblntSn} AND prst.ptcp_inst_sn = #{ptcpInstSn} AND (prst.del_yn IS NULL OR prst.del_yn = 'N') LIMIT 1
